name.sw: Afya Biashara

who.en:
For a small business of about four staff: a shop or kiosk, a restaurant or food stall, a salon or barbershop, a workshop or building site, or a small office. Founder decision D-3 makes the five old Afya Kazini trade kits the sizes of this one business package.

Tanzania’s Occupational Safety and Health (First Aid and Welfare Facilities) Rules 2015 bind every employer. As cited in the old code (the Rules could not be opened here), they require a stocked, marked first-aid box with a treatment record, soap and toilet paper for employees, a clean toilet with a sanitary bin, and safe drinking water. A search result quoting the Rules adds one box and two trained first-aiders for 10–50 employees. Each trade then gets the protection its own risks call for, from WHO’s Five Keys to Safer Food in a kitchen to fresh blades and gloves in a salon and eye and hearing protection in a workshop.

One delivery a month keeps every item in stock, the first-aid box is checked at each delivery, and the business gets one invoice instead of many shop runs.
who.sw:
Kwa biashara ndogo yenye takriban wafanyakazi wanne: duka au kibanda, mgahawa au mama lishe, saluni au kinyozi, karakana au eneo la ujenzi, au ofisi ndogo. Uamuzi wa mwanzilishi D-3 unafanya vifurushi vitano vya zamani vya kazi vya Afya Kazini kuwa ukubwa wa kifurushi hiki kimoja cha biashara.

Kanuni za Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (Huduma ya Kwanza na Ustawi) za Tanzania za 2015 zinamfunga kila mwajiri. Kama zilivyonukuliwa kwenye msimbo wa zamani (Kanuni hazikuweza kufunguliwa hapa), zinataka sanduku la huduma ya kwanza lenye alama na vifaa pamoja na daftari la matibabu, sabuni na karatasi ya chooni kwa wafanyakazi, choo safi chenye pipa la taka za hedhi, na maji salama ya kunywa. Matokeo ya utafutaji yanayonukuu Kanuni yanaongeza sanduku moja na watoa huduma ya kwanza wawili waliofunzwa kwa wafanyakazi 10–50. Kila kazi kisha inapata kinga inayolingana na hatari zake, kuanzia Funguo Tano za WHO za Chakula Salama jikoni hadi viwembe vipya na glavu saluni, na kinga ya macho na masikio karakana.

Usafirishaji mmoja kwa mwezi huweka kila kitu dukani, sanduku la huduma ya kwanza hukaguliwa kila usafirishaji, na biashara inapata ankara moja badala ya safari nyingi za dukani.

clinic_line.en: First aid is for small injuries only. A deep cut, a burn larger than the palm, something in the eye that does not wash out, or any injury with heavy bleeding goes to a health facility straight away. Afya does not sell medicines: the licensed partner pharmacy supplies them.
clinic_line.sw: Huduma ya kwanza ni kwa majeraha madogo tu. Jeraha kubwa, jeraha la moto kubwa kuliko kiganja, kitu jichoni kisichotoka kwa kuosha, au jeraha lolote linalotoa damu nyingi linapelekwa kituo cha afya mara moja. Afya haiuzi dawa: famasia mshirika yenye leseni ndiyo inayozitoa.

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the monthly box goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing (S 3,500 · M 5,000 · L 6,500 per box) and one delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 shares 78% brand / 72% pharm / 50% own) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0. Service fee = r500(partner price × 1.25), partner price = r500(walk-in × 0.70), charged in the month delivered.
